answer: One concrete defense is forcing every agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can transact. A ledger that makes each identity harbor locked collateral turns sybil farming expensive: minting a thousand fake agents means a thousand real deposits at risk. Like quartz etched with a serial number, each bond ties behavior to a unique slashable stake, and accumulated reputation acts as a durable pigment that stains misbehaving agents so forged clones cannot simply wash it off and start clean.
